title: Regular leading-unit evaluation on words
statement: Use the coherent-diagram conventions of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], monoidal infinity-categories of [def-coef-monoidal-infinity-category], the operator category $\mathsf{Chain}_2^\otimes$ of [lem-coef-composable-bimodule-operad-segal], and cocartesian transport of [lem-coef-infinity-pointwise-cocartesian-transport]. Let $\mathcal V$ be a monoidal infinity-category acting coherently on an infinity-category $\mathcal M$, let $A\in\mathcal V$ be an associative unital algebra, and let $Q$ be a coherent left $A$-module in $\mathcal M$, with underlying object $U_AQ$. Encode the regular $(A,A)$-bimodule $A$ (both actions multiplication) and $Q$ by an inert-preserving operadic lift $F$ on $\mathsf{Chain}_2^\otimes$, with values $A,A,A,Q,*$ on $a_0,a_1,p,q,a_2$; the action-valued target sends $a_0,a_1,p$ to its tensor colour, $q$ to its acted-on colour, and $a_2$ to the terminal right colour. Concretely, its restriction to $\mathsf{BM}_{01}$ is the algebra $A$ composed with the map of planar operads $\mathsf{BM}_{01}\to\mathsf{Ass}_1$ sending $a_0,p,a_1$ to $a_1$ and each operation to the unique operation of the same arity. Let $W$ have objects $a_1^kq$ for $k\geq0$ and all block operators retaining the final $q$ and preserving both exterior endpoints; operators and their composition are those of $\mathsf{Chain}_2^\otimes$. Restricting $F$ to $W$ and transporting along total contraction defines a coherent diagram $X:N(W)\to\mathcal M$ with $X(a_1^kq)\simeq A^{\otimes k}\otimes U_AQ$. The arrow $a_1^kq\to a_1^{k+1}q$ whose opposite interval map is $h:[k+2]\to[k+1]$, $h(0)=h(1)=0$, $h(j)=j-1$ for $2\leq j\leq k+2$, evaluates to the leading-unit insertion $\eta_A\otimes\operatorname{id}$. This assertion is in $\mathcal M$ after forgetting any external left action, and no linearity of the leading-unit map is asserted. No colimits are assumed.
